ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, what would happen to ants if all the plants died?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: At the top of the food web there is a plant labeled “plant”; below the plant on the left is an ant labeled “ant,” and there is an arrow pointing from plant to ant. The image also shows ant pointing to lizard, and plant also pointing to the poison dart on the right. Reasoning: The arrows in the food web indicate that food or energy flows from the source to the consumer. Because plant points to ant, this shows that ants depend on plants as a food/energy source. If all the plants died, ants would lose this food source, so the number of ants would decrease.
